h: פָּרָשַׁת כִּי תָבוֹא, ה׳ Ki Savo, 5
Rest Blessing and Holiness at the Three Shabbos Meals

p: "And He rested on the seventh day...
and God blessed the seventh day
to be within the power of their endeavor,
You have given to Your people."
is the matter of the shining of the root
which is above human intellect and grasp.
of the three meals of Shabbos,
which correspond to the three aspects
for Shabbos is Shin and bas,
which is crowned with the Avos,
the holiness of the Field of Apples,
that is, the arousal of fear
from the aspect of the souls of Yisrael,
that the King of the kings of kings,
the Holy One, Blessed is He, stands before him;
and this is the aspect of
Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
which shines at the entry of Shabbos
as they said, of blessed memory (Yerushalmi Demai 4:1):
the awe of Shabbos is upon him";
and from this is born the rest
in the heart of the receiver,
each in the house of her husband";
and I have found no rest."
הוּא בְּחִינַת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
is the aspect of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
"and they shall sanctify the Holy One of Yaakov";
in the point of truth, in hiddenness,
is the shining of fear in the heart
from the side of the attribute of faith alone;
in the inner point of the heart,
in the aspect of truth from above.
from the source, from the aspect of mazal,
for the bestowal of children, life and sustenance,
And regarding them the term blessing is used:
"And He will bless the fruit of your womb" (Devarim 7:13)
"the blessing of Hashem, it makes rich" (Mishlei 10:22)
and I will remove illness from your midst" (Shemos 23:25)
this is the blessing of life.
And this corresponds to the aspect of the holiness
of Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
to whom it was said "and be a blessing,"
for he cleaved to the source of blessing.
are alluded to in three holy Names:
the Name Adnus, the Name Havayah,
Union is from the Name Adnus,
and it is the aspect of rest,
of Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
and this is the completeness of union,
each in the house of her husband";
and as it says in the holy Zohar (II 135a):
in the union of holy light."
is the aspect of the source of blessing,
And therefore it is said of him,
to subdue the husk of Esav (Bereishis 32:23):
"and he crossed the ford of Yabbok";
for by the power of the completeness of these holinesses
in the three meals of Shabbos,
